performance.verdict: Ads dark since Aug 6 — 29 leads this month are stale, not current.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 for 18 consecutive days (Aug 6–23); all 29 leads and $741.52 in spend belong to the prior active window.
GHL shows 29 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — every lead from the active run sits unworked in pipeline.
3-day trend (Aug 21–23): ig_reach spiked to 210, 150, 182 vs near-zero prior 3 days — organic Instagram active while paid is dark; cause unknown.
GBP actions +16.28% (7d) and search clicks +16.38% — organic demand is holding up despite paid going dark; not reflected in signed cases.
GA4 sessions -26.86% (7d), directional only given known double-count issue; consistent with paid traffic cutoff on Aug 6.

suggestions.text: Urgently diagnose why Meta spend dropped to $0 on Aug 6 — account suspension, billing, or manual pause; restore or escalate.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 18 consecutive days (Aug 6–23), halting all lead flow from the $65–75/day active campaign. Immediately check account status, billing, and campaign-level pause flags in Ads Manager. Success is confirmed when daily spend resumes at or near $65/day and GHL begins receiving new contacts. This must be resolved before Aug 27 or the 3-lead/day July volume target is unrecoverable for August.

suggestions.text: Escalate to Andrew: 29 GHL contacts at $0 opportunities created — intake has not processed a single lead from the July–Aug run.
suggestions.monday_update: All 29 leads captured before Aug 6 show in GHL as contacts, but 0 opportunities were created and 0 appointments booked. This is an intake processing failure, not an ads problem. Andrew must audit the GHL pipeline and confirm whether contacts were worked, disqualified, or simply missed. Success check: at least 20 of the 29 contacts have an opportunity stage and a disposition entered by Aug 28.

suggestions.text: Watch IG reach spike (210–182 reach, Aug 21–23) — identify source before crediting or acting on it.
suggestions.monday_update: Instagram reach jumped from near-zero to 182–210 over Aug 21–23 with no active paid spend; this is likely organic posting or a boosted reel outside tracked campaigns. Do not attribute lead quality to this until the source is confirmed. Re-check on Aug 27 — if reach sustains above 150/day and any GHL contacts trace to Instagram, escalate to Hamza/Hamdan for attribution.
